description: E02 formal contract corrected on 2026-07-28: indeterminate eggplant MDAP is diagnostic-only; cumulative dry harvest CHPDT and single-harvest dry mass HPODW share one harvest-family Phi budget; cumulative fresh harvest CHFPW does not enter Phi.
